'''Vargai Javis'''<ref name="Follow">{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Follow-up on Karrels Javis|Watcher Three}}</ref> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a son of [[Karrels Javis]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Vargai and his brother [[Serjil Javis|Serjil]] encountered a [[Unidentified Sith apprentice (Karrels Javis's sons)|Sith apprentice]] in Imperial space and a dispute broke out. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] killed Serjil and crippled Vargai,<ref name="Change of Plans" /> who was transferred to the hospital ship [[Anodyne (starship)|''Anodyne'']] to recover. However, the incident disrupted an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation involving Karrels Javis, and Karrels was [[Death/Legends|killed]] shortly after learning what happened. As a loose end, Vargai was placed under surveillance, and [[Watcher Three (Galactic War)|Watcher Three]] reported that they could have an asset alter the chemical balance of Vargai's [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] tank to extend his recovery time indefinitely.<ref name="Follow" />
